		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {

tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_clergy_desired_pop = 1
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_great_port_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = large_port_building_time
	construction_demand = port_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_migration_attraction = 1
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 3
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_dynastic_necropolis = {
	is_special = yes
	audio_tier = 6
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_DIRECT_BUILDING_ENABLED_TT
			has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build
		}
		location_rank ?= location_rank:rural_settlement
	}
	can_destroy = {
		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 4
				var:tv_wonder_site ?= { this = root }
			}
		}
	}

	price = tv_wonder_direct_build_large_price

	build_time = huge_unique_build_time
	construction_demand = library_construction

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
		pop_join_rebel_threshold = -0.025
		pop_leave_rebels_threshold = -0.025
		monthly_towards_traditionalist = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_necropolis_maintenance
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_giant_necropolis arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9404 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_completed arg1 = tv_wonder_giant_necropolis arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				tv_wonder_trigger_final_building_completion_sync_hidden_event_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	possible_production_methods = {

			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_hydraulic_workshop arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9406 days = 1 }

		}

tv_wonder_hydraulic_workshop_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = laborers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.002
		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 6
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = government_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_large_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_trade_center_power = 0.5
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 9
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		local_pop_conversion_speed = 0.01
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
		monthly_towards_spiritualist = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {

	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9412 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {

tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_pop_assimilation_speed = 0.01
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 12
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
		always = yes
	}
	can_destroy = {
		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 15
				var:tv_wonder_site ?= { this = root }
			}
		}

		local_cultural_influence = 0.5

		local_max_control = 0.1

	}

		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {

				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9415 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {

tv_wonder_star_fortress_city_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = military_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = small_fort_building
	construction_demand = fort_construction

	modifier = {
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	raw_modifier = {
		fort_level = 2
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 15
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_library_of_nation_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_max_literacy = 10
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 18
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_giant_dam_project_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = laborers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_population_capacity = 10
		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 21
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_institution_growth_modifier = 0.5
		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 23
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_coastal_beacon_network_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = military_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = large_port_building_time
	construction_demand = port_building_construction

	modifier = {
		max_ships_built_at_same_time = 1
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 26
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 29

			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		local_build_buildings_efficiency = 0.1
		monthly_towards_inward = 0.05
	}

	on_destroyed = {

			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9429 days = 1 }

tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_rgo_build_time = -0.4
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 29
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = government_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_crown_estate_power = 1
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 32
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_DIRECT_BUILDING_ENABLED_TT
			has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build
		}
		OR = {
			location_rank ?= location_rank:city
			location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
			raw_material = goods:goods_gold
			raw_material = goods:silver
			raw_material = goods:copper
		}
	}
	can_destroy = {
		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 35
				var:tv_wonder_site ?= { this = root }
			}
		}
	}

	price = tv_wonder_direct_build_medium_price

	build_time = huge_unique_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		minting_income_factor = 0.1
		monthly_towards_capital_economy = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_royal_mint_system arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9435 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_completed arg1 = tv_wonder_royal_mint_system arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				tv_wonder_trigger_final_building_completion_sync_hidden_event_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_royal_mint_system_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = government_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_raw_material_output = 0.25
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 35
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_giant_workshop_complex_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = infrastructure_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_pop_promotion_speed_modifier = 0.5
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 38
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes

	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_DIRECT_BUILDING_ENABLED_TT
			has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build
		}
		always = yes
	}
	can_destroy = {
		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 41
				var:tv_wonder_site ?= { this = root }
			}
		}
	}

	price = tv_wonder_direct_build_medium_price

	build_time = huge_unique_build_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		tolerance_heretic = 0.5
		tolerance_heathen = 0.5
		monthly_towards_traditionalist = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_sacred_monument_maintenance
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_megalithic_circle arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9441 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_completed arg1 = tv_wonder_megalithic_circle arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				tv_wonder_trigger_final_building_completion_sync_hidden_event_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_megalithic_circle_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 1
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 41
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = military_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = small_fort_building
	construction_demand = fort_construction

	modifier = {
		local_unrest = -0.2
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 46
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_admiralty_navigation_school = {
	is_special = yes
	audio_tier = 5
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = military_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_DIRECT_BUILDING_ENABLED_TT
			has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build
		}
		is_port = yes
	}
	can_destroy = {
		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 47
				var:tv_wonder_site ?= { this = root }
			}
		}
	}

	price = tv_wonder_direct_build_medium_price

	build_time = huge_unique_build_time
	construction_demand = fort_construction

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		monthly_navy_tradition = 0.05
		monthly_towards_quality = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_port_monument_maintenance
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_naval_school arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9447 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_completed arg1 = tv_wonder_naval_school arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				tv_wonder_trigger_final_building_completion_sync_hidden_event_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

		legislative_efficiency = 0.1
		monthly_towards_conciliatory = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_axis_monument_maintenance
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_great_assembly_hall arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9449 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_completed arg1 = tv_wonder_great_assembly_hall arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }
				}
				tv_wonder_trigger_final_building_completion_sync_hidden_event_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_great_assembly_hall_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = government_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_max_literacy = 0.1
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 49
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

			location = {
				owner = {
					cmf_log_with_args = { action = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_destroyed arg1 = tv_wonder_summer_palace arg2 = tv_engineering_department_cmf_log_final_wonder_building }

	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		free_building_levels = 25
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 52
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = large_port_building_time
	construction_demand = port_building_construction

	modifier = {
		harbor_suitability = 0.1
		local_maritime_presence = 0.1
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 101
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 1
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
